It is not owned by a standalone Translate app. The primary user-facing product is the built-in Translate Space, while Write, Mail, Boards, Browse, Vision & Voice, AI Overlay, Sites and other authorised surfaces may invoke Dulche Translate directly for contextual translation.

source_rows.canonical_text: Dulche MUST expose a canonical request-aware Tool Registry describing the tools, executable capabilities and usable resources that a model can employ to satisfy a request. The registry is broader than a literal list of function names: it includes first-party 9to1 app actions/APIs, Automations actions, Plugins, MCP tools, callable Agents, Skills that contribute executable workflows through authorised dependencies, Files/resource retrieval, image/audio/video generation capabilities, code/shell tools, web/network tools where permitted and other registered Dulche capabilities. Computer Use is represented only when it has been explicitly invoked under the Computer Use contract.

source_rows.canonical_text: Every registry entry MUST use stable identity and structured metadata. At minimum it exposes ToolID/CapabilityID, source type and owner, version/revision, human-readable name, action IDs, semantic capability/intent tags, supported input/output types, parameter schemas, prerequisites, permission scopes, side-effect/risk classification, platform/scope constraints, availability/health and whether user approval or additional configuration is currently required. Display name and wording of an action MUST NOT be the sole mechanism used to decide what a tool can do.

source_rows.canonical_text: Dulche MUST derive an EffectiveCapabilitySet for each request from the canonical registry. The effective set is filtered by the active user/profile, current app/Space/project, installed/enabled package state, app/API availability, explicit @ invocations, platform capability, privacy policy, administrator policy, current permissions/trust and any request-specific restrictions. Installed-but-unavailable, available-but-unapproved and immediately executable capabilities MUST remain distinguishable.

Capability discovery MUST nevertheless remain available throughout the request and MUST refresh when packages, permissions, target apps or connection state materially change.

A tool does not need an action whose literal name matches the user's wording when its underlying capability can satisfy the requested effect.

source_rows.canonical_text: For example, a request such as 'remind me tomorrow at 4 PM' MUST be resolvable to a time-triggered Automations operation even if no action is literally named CreateReminder. source_rows.canonical_text: Capability resolution MUST support composition. If no single tool can fulfil the complete request but a sequence of authorised capabilities can, Dulche MUST be able to construct a typed ResolutionPlan whose steps pass structured outputs/references between tools. For example, a request to 'create an image and put it on the title slide' may resolve to image generation followed by Present insertion; a request to 'find the file and email it' may resolve to Files search followed by a Mail/Plugin send action, subject to normal permissions and approvals.

source_rows.canonical_text: A capability that exists but is missing a prerequisite MUST be described as blocked/configuration-required rather than impossible. Apps and Agents consume the same canonical compacted session state rather than implementing incompatible private compaction.

source_rows.canonical_text: Compaction MUST be non-destructive to durable history. source_rows.canonical_text: Context Summarisation is a distinct Dulche job. A summariser model reads the retained conversation/history section by section using bounded windows so the summariser's own context cannot overflow. Each section produces a structured intermediate summary containing obligations, facts, decisions, identifiers, artifacts/references, completed actions, unresolved work/blockers, provenance and continuity notes. Dulche then performs one or more bounded merge passes until a final execution summary fits the target context budget.

source_rows.canonical_text: The Persistent Skill MUST use the canonical Dulche persistent-request contract.
